Class InternationalizationStrategy.USEDEFAULT

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.platform.models.annotations.InternationalizationStrategy.USEDEFAULT
  • All Implemented Interfaces:

    InternationalizationStrategy
    public static class InternationalizationStrategy.USEDEFAULT
extends Object
implements InternationalizationStrategy
    Signifies the use of a default InternationalizationStrategy - for use as "no value" in annotations. Don't use this otherwise; calling it throws exceptions.
